channel.title: Business Insider France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider France (businessinsider.fr)

item.title: Trump threatens to block the opening of a bridge between Ontario and Michigan in ongoing spat with Canada
item.description: President Donald Trump demanded the US own half of the Gordie Howe International Bridge between the US and Canada, or he would block it from opening.

item.title: Salesforce appoints 6 new leaders in an executive shake-up after 5 high-profile departures
item.description: Salesforce has hired or promoted six new leaders, replacing five high-profile leaders who have announced departures from the company since December.

item.title: Salesforce quietly laid off workers in a new round of cuts
item.description: Salesforce trims staff in marketing, product, and data teams, affecting fewer than 1,000 roles. The company recently had a leadership overhaul.

item.title: Olympic skier Lindsey Vonn, 41, says she has a tibia fracture and no regrets
item.description: Lindsay Vonn's dad said that he wants her to step away from racing — if he has any say in the matter.

item.title: A16z partner says that the theory that we'll vibe code everything is 'flat wrong'
item.description: Vibe coding everything is just not worth it, says A16z partner Anish Acharya.

item.title: Drones on Ukraine's frontline perform so unpredictably in frigid weather that it's like 'Russian roulette': commander
item.description: Sr. Lt. Serhii Andrieiev told Business Insider that the cold can disrupt anything from the drone's camera lens, to its battery, to its aerodynamics.

item.title: I've traveled to over 40 countries. These 5 bucket-list destinations left me disappointed.
item.description: To Andre Neveling, the hippy vibe in Bali feels less like a genuine search for peace and more like an overdone tourist trend.

item.title: Elon Musk said he'll congratulate Blue Origin if they land on the moon before SpaceX — he's focused on something else
item.description: Elon Musk says SpaceX is now "more the tortoise than the hare" as it shifts focus to building a "self-growing city" on the moon.

item.title: Chappell Roan leaves Casey Wasserman's talent agency after he appeared in the Epstein files
item.description: Chappell Roan is leaving Wasserman agency. CEO Casey Wasserman appeared in the Epstein files in emails he exchanged with Ghislaine Maxwell.

item.title: Russian troops installed giant steel weed whackers on a vehicle to fend off drone attacks
item.description: The setup, featured on Russian state media, is supposed to spin steel cables that whack incoming FPV drones or at least keep their explosions at bay.
